question: Can the design skill directly assess an existing proposal when its review sibling is absent, identifying the crash window without inventing provider guarantees?

criteria.expectation: Identifies a crash after order commit and before publication as a reachable event-loss window under the supplied design.
criteria.evidence: Analysis names both operations and explains why separate retries alone do not close that window.

criteria.expectation: Assesses the draft directly and proposes a viable direction, such as durable transactional event recording, with tradeoffs or needed proof.
criteria.evidence: Recommendation and treatment of unknown guarantees; no mandatory number of alternatives.

criteria.expectation: Does not accept the ADR or claim exactly-once/provider guarantees beyond supplied evidence.

catalog_note: Preserve the original optional-sibling-absent case: only design-architecture is exposed in available/loaded conditions; baseline has all skills disabled. Record this reduced-catalog experiment separately from normal-catalog ablations.
provenance: Retains the proposal and constraints of manual scenario S5; neutral request supports baseline and native loaded conditions.
